newsitem.title: USA: Dow drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in early afternoon trading on Monday after an early recovery from Friday's rout failed to hold.
At 12:56 p.m. EDT, the 30-share Dow was off 51.33 points at 7,643.33, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
